entries.title: Defer syntax highlighting while the assistant response is streaming
entries.trigger: WP06 foundation policies existed but the live assistant bubble still ran the final syntax-highlighting pipeline on every token update.
entries.telemetry_change: No telemetry fields, labels, sinks, or retention behavior changed.
entries.rollback: Revert the streaming prop and renderer plugin selection; completed-message rendering and stored content are unaffected.

entries.title: Privacy-safe telemetry and change-impact drift gate
entries.trigger: WP09 requires correlated operations evidence without chat content leakage and requires documentation drift to fail CI.
entries.telemetry_change: Adds a local record validator only; no sink, network export, user content, token text, attachment content, session ID or user ID is collected.
entries.rollback: Revert the additive telemetry, checker, tests, workflow/template wiring, manifest entry and records; no API, DB, runtime route or production flag changes.

entries.title: Scoped draft, composer, upload, artifact and model provenance policies
entries.trigger: WP07 requires tenant/user/session/branch/tab isolation and stale callback rejection before production composer wiring.
entries.telemetry_change: No telemetry sink or payload is added; draft text, upload bodies and model/account identifiers remain outside telemetry.
entries.rollback: Revert the additive policy, test, manifest and documentation files; no runtime route, API, DB, storage key or deployed behavior changes.
